cells.gaps: No source found says a law, decree or regulation that sets a rule for AI is in force.
cells.note: The ICT ministry said in September 2025 that it had developed a draft AI bill, which the Speaker had said in June was being finalised: a text begun in a ministry is a draft (ruling 171). The minister's word of August 2026 that no legislation has been introduced does not undo it, and no rule is in force, so not 3.
